Order 
The petitioners are the accused in Crime No.293 of 2022 registered at the Aluva East Police Station alleging commission of the offence under Section 498A read with Section 34 IPC.
This Bail Application is pending without any interim order from 30/03/2022 onwards.

The Bail Application is hence disposed of directing the Investigating Officer to issue notice to the petitioners under Section 41A of Cr.P.C, if any crime is registered against them based on the allegations mentioned in this Bail Application and the petitioners have so far not been questioned.

Sd/-
